meta.title: Rust migration
meta.description: Migrates TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby or Java code to Rust, one function or a whole app: the engine records the original's behavior and reports differences while the agent writes the port. PHP and C# get analysis and whole-app recording without unit bridging. Ask to migrate code or to make one hot path faster. Read-only analyze and map run immediately; the other 20 engine tools (bridge, record, build, diff, bench, gate, go and more) write files or run project code, so each call needs one fresh approval. Recording and replay execute the target app and builds need its own toolchain, so use trusted projects that already build. Adds the rust-anything skill and two prompt templates. Engine 3.3.0 is bundled for Windows x64; macOS and Linux need DSH_RUST_ANYTHING_BIN set to the absolute path of a trusted 3.3.0 executable. Timeouts and output limits are DSH_RUST_ANYTHING_* host settings. Disabling removes the tools, prompts and skill.
